t: This is the Captain Kidd, a pub in Wapping, and a Grade Two listed building that was once a coffee warehouse. It's named after William Kidd, the seventeenth-century pirate, who was executed at the nearby Execution Dock. Kidd was a Scottish privateer, probably born in Dundee, who later settled in New York. By 1690 he had become a highly successful privateer, commissioned to protect English interests in the American colonies and the West Indies.
